purpose: Teach: 村井/多田/若林/上原/河合/石橋/西口/望月

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 村井部長の歓迎会を準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's get the welcome reception organized for Director Murai.
lines.style: Efficient and clear. Opens with quiet authority—she's given this kind of task before. Brisk pace, no hesitation. The tone of someone moving through a list with purpose.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。多田課長の引き継ぎ書を確認します
lines.en: Got it. I'll check through Manager Tada's handover notes.
lines.style: Affirming without fanfare. Quick, attentive. The reliable acknowledgment of someone who tracks what's been assigned. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 若林技術主任のプロジェクト進捗を共有しましょう
lines.en: And let's share an update on Wakabayashi's technical project status.
lines.style: Steady direction. She's building a list now, moving between priorities. Matter-of-fact tone, connecting items. No rush, but no stalling either.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。上原広報の月次企画書を確認します
lines.en: Understood. I'll review Uehara's monthly proposal documents.
lines.style: Confirmatory and immediate. Light clip to his words—he's keeping pace. The voice of someone taking notes and ready for the next item.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 河合顧問との面談を予定しましょう
lines.en: We should schedule a meeting with Kawai, the advisor.
lines.style: Directive but collaborative. Slight emphasis on 'should'—she's checking in rather than commanding. Steady eye-contact level in her voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。石橋取締役のスケジュールを整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll coordinate Director Ishibashi's calendar availability.
lines.style: Brief and capable. He's moving to the next task without ceremony. Small pause before 'calendar'—he's thinking through logistics even as he speaks.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 西口海外担当の出張報告を共有しましょう
lines.en: Let's hear the overseas trip report from Nishiguchi.
lines.style: Directive with openness. She's moving into new information now—slight lift in attention. Not rushed, but ready to receive. Clear and present.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。望月法務の新契約レビューを進めます
lines.en: Understood. I'll move forward with the legal team's contract review.
lines.style: Final confirmation. A touch of closure in his delivery—this feels like the last item on the list. Steady, assured. He's committing to it.
